integrity: A self-contained proof and independently implemented exhaustive finite checker are included; finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact matrix-sum enumeration and a doubleton closed form; not a general closed maximization formula for unequal part sizes. No independent mathematical audit or definitive external priority determination.
title: Geodesic-packing polynomials of complete multipartite graphs and reentrant purity for doubleton parts
